purpose: Acquire a pinned Qwen3.5-9B Q4_K_M candidate on the existing dedicated model host for read-only A/B evaluation against the current Qwen3-8B. This scope does not activate or route production traffic to the candidate.
boundaries: current tai-qwen3-8b.service stays active and is not restarted or reconfigured
candidate bytes are stored outside Git under /srv/tai-models/candidates
candidate cannot satisfy production model provenance or admission by itself
all transport uses the existing pinned dedicated model-host SSH identity
candidate activation requires a later bounded serial A/B controller with automatic rollback
